layout.grid_system: Mode B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Dense, sharp, every pixel utilized. Use h-full on children.
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Strict 1px borders, ZERO soft shadows. Use sharp edges.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-[#002277] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[#E4E4E7] border border-border transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold text-sm
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-[#CC2200] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold text-sm
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-semibold text-sm

cards.base: bg-card border border-border rounded-none p-6 transition-colors duration-200

inputs.base: border border-border bg-background px-4 py-2.5 rounded-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent text-sm w-full transition-shadow placeholder:text-muted-foreground

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 border text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none

motion.entrance: staggered fade-in using framer-motion for dashboard widgets
motion.micro: active:scale-[0.98] on buttons for tactile feedback

icons.usage: Use bold or regular weights for sharp technical look. Phosphor is ideal for dense dashboards.

data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, widgets, and key metrics MUST have a role-based kebab-case data-testid (e.g., data-testid='review-risks-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Completely eradicate the current teal brand color (#2597B2) and replace it with the new Archetype 4 Swiss palette: International Klein Blue (#002FA7) as primary, stark black (#0A0A0A) and pure white (#FFFFFF).
2. Replace all instances of `rounded-*` and `shadow-*` utility classes with `rounded-none` and sharp 1px borders (`border-border`) to achieve the Swiss Brutalist/Technical look.
3. Dashboard Simplification: Remove the 6 disconnected stat cards. Implement a 4-column top metric row highlighting ONLY: Overall Compliance, Open Risks, Overdue Audits, Pending Tasks.

4. Action-Oriented Design: Implement a 'Command Bar' at the top of the dashboard. Instead of just showing a score, it should be a full-width high-contrast banner (using primary or dark background) that says exactly what needs attention and provides a direct CTA (e.g., 'Review 5 Open Risks').

5. Structural Consistency: Standardize layout using the CSS Grid 'Control Room' Mode. The dashboard should feel like a tight, cohesive instrument panel. Use Recharts for the heatmap and bar charts, customized with the new color palette (stark lines, no curved bars).
6. UX Improvements: Consolidate 'Overdue items', 'Upcoming activities', and 'Recent activity' into a single, tabbed 'Activity Center' widget to reduce visual clutter.
7. Typography: Inject Fontshare 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and Google 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text in the global CSS. Apply tracking-tight to all headings.
8. Add robust empty states with clear CTAs and Phosphor icons for any empty data views.
9. Use Shadcn components for complex logic but strictly override their default styles to match the flat, sharp, brutalist Swiss UI.
